comment: OpenEMS backend edge registry (Metadata.File). The backend reads this ONCE at startup and caches it — restart the backend after editing (register-edge.sh does this for you). Each edge: key = edge-id (its trailing digits become the InfluxDB numeric tag, so they must be globally unique); apikey = the secret the edge presents on connect (unknown apikeys are rejected); comment = free-text metadata (persisted). For the P1 simulator edges the apikey is just the edge-id (not secret); real Pi edges get a random secret from register-edge.sh.

slrp4-09.comment: Synergy Logic SL-RP4 (real Pi) — apikey redacted for publication; rotate via register-edge.sh --rotate
